actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
d = "/var/lib/failover"
# FENCE the old primary durably: write temp, fsync, rename, fsync dir
tmp = d + "/.fenced.tmp"
with open(tmp, "w") as f:
    f.write("old primary 127.0.0.1:8081 fenced at promotion\n")
    f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.rename(tmp, d + "/primary.fenced")
dirfd = os.open(d, os.O_RDONLY)
os.fsync(dirfd); os.close(dirfd)
print("fenced:", os.path.exists(d + "/primary.fenced"), "| failed preserved:", os.path.exists(d + "/primary.failed"))
PY

actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
d = "/var/lib/failover"
def atomic_write(path, content):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w") as f:
        f.write(content); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.rename(tmp, path)
    dirfd = os.open(d, os.O_RDONLY); os.fsync(dirfd); os.close(dirfd)
# Promote replica to primary (fence already in place)
atomic_write(d + "/replica.role", "primary\n")
# Switch proxy upstream to the promoted node
atomic_write(d + "/upstream", "8082\n")
print("role:", open(d + "/replica.role").read().strip(), "| upstream:", open(d + "/upstream").read().strip())
PY
actions.description: Atomically promote replica and switch proxy upstream
actions.output_excerpt: role: primary | upstream: 8082
